subject: Engagement cadence & owner onboarding plan — FinServ Analytics trial
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@finserv.co>, Mark Liu <mark.liu@finserv.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Engagement cadence & owner onboarding plan — FinServ Analytics trial

Hi Elena / Mark — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can mobilize the trial without friction.

Recap (from our discussion)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference on customer-facing analytics pipelines for real-time scoring (latency 50–150ms p50, cost target $0.002/token equivalent).
- Primary success criteria: 1) stable 95th percentile latency under 400ms for 1k qps synthetic, 2) parity on accuracy benchmarks for the 3 core prompts in the workbook, 3) no PII exfiltration per automated checks.

Proposed timeline
- Dec 10: kickoff + infra checklist sign-off
- Dec 12–22: trial execution (ingest sample traffic, run evaluation sets, daily metrics digest)
- Dec 23–24: final validation and executive review

Who we need from your side (please confirm owners)
- Infra owner (network/VPC + data flow): __________________
- App/product owner (integration points, API keys, test dataset): __________________
- Security/compliance contact (SaaS review + questionnaire): __________________
- Procurement / legal POC (SOW / PO / vendor onboarding): __________________

Internal ownership (initial proposal)
- Technical lead / infra: Priyom Das (integration and env prep)
- Implementation / app integration: Kimberly Park
- Security liaison + questionnaire response: Ben Carter
- Sales / engagement lead: Aditya Rao (me)

Immediate asks
1) Please confirm names and best email for the four owners above by EOD Friday (Dec 4).
2) If procurement has a vendor portal or specific contract milestones, share links and timeline.
3) Accept the attached POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx and SOW_draft.docx if those look OK; I’ll push the DocuSign once we align.

I’ve attached a short success-criteria workbook and a draft SOW to accelerate legal/procurement. If you prefer a different cadence (e.g., two-week trial instead of 10 business days) say so and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — calendar invites to follow once owners confirmed.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference — inference that scales

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, SOW_draft.docx

From: Elena Torres <elena@finserv.co>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Liu <mark.liu@finserv.co>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@finserv.co>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement cadence & owner onboarding plan — FinServ Analytics trial

Aditya — great summary, thanks. Couple quick notes and owners from our side: 

Owners we’ll assign
- Infra / cloud: Mark Liu (mark.liu@finserv.co) — he owns VPC and internal networking.
- App / product: Elena Torres (me) — integration, sample datasets, acceptance prompts.
- Security / compliance: Mark Liu (he’ll coordinate with our InfoSec) — primary contact for the questionnaire is lisa.park@finserv.co but Mark will brief her.
- Procurement / legal: Lisa Park (lisa.park@finserv.co) — she runs vendor onboarding and contract sign-off.

Procurement notes
- We use a vendor portal (I’ll share access) and typically need a PO; target for PO is Dec 22 if we can get SOW to legal by Dec 8.
- Vendor onboarding questionnaire attached — fill and return by Dec 6 if possible.

Timeline: Dec 12 kickoff is workable for us but we need the SOW signed (or at least agreed) by Dec 10 to get internal approvals.

I attached the completed vendor questionnaire and marked a couple redlines in the SOW that our legal will want clarified (liability cap and data deletion clause). We can sync on those during the kickoff.

Thanks — looping Lisa and Mark here.

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement cadence & owner onboarding plan — internal next steps

Aditya / team — quick internal note after Elena’s reply. I’ll own the security questionnaire back-channel and coordinate legal redlines. Proposed RACI for the trial (high level):

- Responsible (R) — does the work / executes
  - Infra setup and test environment: Priyom Das
  - App integration and sample dataset ingestion: Kimberly Park
  - Security questionnaire & checks: Ben Carter
  - Trial reporting & metrics dashboard: Aditya Rao / Priyom Das (shared)

- Accountable (A) — final sign-off for each area
  - Infra: Priyom Das
  - App/integration: Kimberly Park
  - Security/compliance: Ben Carter
  - Business acceptance: Aditya Rao

- Consulted (C)
  - Legal & procurement: send SOW to legal review once redlines noted (I’ll own this).
  - Platform reliability: Engineering on-call for any infra tuning during trial.

- Informed (I)
  - Sales leadership and CS (weekly digest).

Procurement action items
- Aditya: send updated SOW with Ben’s redline notes by EOD 12/4.
- Priyom: prep a minimal infra runbook (VPC, subnets, egress rules, expected IP ranges) — see drive link.
- Kimberly: share sample ingestion script and data sample schema by 12/7.
- Ben: I’ll return the vendor questionnaire with answers and a short security summary by 12/6 (attaching interim Security_QA_Response.pdf).

Marking owners in the HubSpot deal and I’ll create the internal kickoff invite once SOW updated.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Security_QA_Response.pdf

Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Engagement cadence & owner onboarding plan — confirmation and kickoff

Elena / Mark / Lisa — thanks for confirming owners and the procurement timeline. Next steps from our side: 

1) I’ve updated the SOW with Ben’s flagged clauses and pushed to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s/FS-2026-087/sow (please review).
2) Internal kickoff scheduled for Mon, Dec 12 at 10:00 AM PT — calendar invites sent to owners.
3) Priyom will share the infra runbook and temporary credentials by Dec 9.
4) Kimberly will post the sample ingestion script and acceptance prompts to the shared drive folder by Dec 7.
5) Ben will upload the final security summary and questionnaire responses by Dec 6.

One ask from procurement: Lisa, if you can confirm whether FinServ needs a redlined SOW back or if a signed DocuSign copy is sufficient for your PO process, that’d be helpful.

We’ll prepare a daily metrics digest during the trial and a final exec summary for the Dec 23 review. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
